title: Room Under the TRICARE Select Family Catastrophic Cap for a Reprocessed Line
content:
**Standing rule.** Where the family catastrophic total of a **TRICARE Select** cap-reprocessed line (the Select liability posted less the liability withdrawn, plus the enrollment fees added, plus any amount credited from TRICARE Prime) has reached the tier's family catastrophic cap, the line carries no liability; where the room left under the cap is less than the liability figured before the cap, the liability is cut to that room, rounded to the cent; otherwise the liability is the one figured before the cap.

The liability figured before the cap is the deductible and cost share figured on the line; the Select liability posted and withdrawn are the beneficiary liability on the enrollment's claim lines and on their reversals.

## Caps (US dollars per calendar plan year)

| Tier | Cap |
|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | 1000.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | 1000.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | 1252.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | 1252.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | 3000.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | 4034.00 |

## Both sides of the cap (hypothetical, TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, cap 3000.00, liability figured 140.00)

| Family catastrophic total | Room | Liability carried |
|---|---|---|
| 3100.00 | none | 0.00 |
| 3000.00 | none | 0.00 |
| 2950.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 |
| 2860.00 | 140.00 | 140.00 |
| 1000.00 | 2000.00 | 140.00 |
